mapper.select: select mn.* from Sys_File mn where mn.T_Code is not null and mn.FileCreateUser is not null and mn.T_Id is not null and mn.FileFlowStatus=7 and (mn.file_Jm_Archive=false or mn.file_Jm_Archive is null) and (mn.FileProject is not null or mn.FileSectionID is not null or mn.FileContract is not null) and (select count(*) from SYS_FileTemplate_Print tp where tp.T_Id=mn.T_Id and tp.Tp_State=1 and tp.Tp_Type='jimuReport' and tp.Tp_Api_Url is not null and (tp.Te_Id=mn.Te_Id or mn.Te_Id is null))>0 and mn.T_Code not like '%_Flow' limit #{size}
